description: Make a user an app moderator (`moderator: true`) or remove them (`false`): it adds them to, or takes them out of, the app's reserved group `moderators`. `userId` is the per-app user id (from neblla_list_users with the same env), not an email. The group lives in the app's data: with env "pre" and a pre with its own data, it names a moderator of pre (the developer adds themselves to moderate there); a pre on pro's data shares pro's.

env.description: Whose moderators: "pro" (the users', default) or "pre" (its own unless it plays with pro's data)

name: neblla_set_moderator
